LanguageData.WotF_ForestBloodline.description: An ancient bloodline coursing through the elves. Carriers naturally hold mana and can awaken spellbooks that remain inert in ordinary hands. Through continued spellcasting, the bloodline's affinity for mana deepens while allowing the body to endure greater neural heat.
LanguageData.WotF_ForestBloodline.label: forest bloodline
LanguageData.WotF_ForestBloodline.resourceDescription: The mana reserve stored within a caster and spent as needed when casting spells. Maximum mana depends primarily on the growth of the bloodline, and can be expanded further with higher-tier spellbooks or suitable gear.
